title: My Technical Perspectives
logline: What I value and what I hope to achieve within the first 6 months

rows: KISS (Keep it simple, stupid)
A failed translation leaves no successful row, so the next daily run picks it up. No retry scheduler needed
Single source of truth
AI Wiki stores team knowledge, code detail stays in service repos
Separation of concerns
The AI wiki holds knowledge, the skills repo holds tool calls, and workflows orchestrate both
Systemize the second time, not the first
Systemize only when a problem repeats, and only if the tradeoffs are worth it
Make the safe path the fast path
Spec Workflow speeds up development time whilst automating safety checks
Write it down so it scales past me
Facts in the wiki, procedures in skills
Coordinate multiple coding agents
Manage several coding agents in one workspace
Cut time to release
Tighten the Spec Workflow and its coding loop. Keep human approval for risky changes only
Make evals cheaper
Go deeper on evals, and reduce what they cost in tokens and in upkeep
